name: Todd Blanche
description: Follow Todd Blanche, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Blanche's path to confirmation appears clear after winning key Republican's support
changes.summary: A key Republican senator, Bill Cassidy of Louisiana, said he would back Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, smoothing the path for his ultimate confirmation by the Senate. (Image credit: Kevin Dietsch).

changes.title: Blanche on track for narrow Senate confirmation as attorney general
changes.summary: At the U.S. Capitol, it was a wild day of decision and indecision. The Senate passed the toughest sanctions bill on Russia yet and is also now on track to confirm Todd Blanche as attorney general. But a slew of other high-priority items are still tangled, largely due to a Republican divide. Congressional correspondent.

changes.title: Sen. Cassidy says he'll vote to confirm Todd Blanche for attorney general
changes.summary: Republican Sen. Bill Cassidy said Friday he will back Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, likely paving the way for Blanche to be confirmed to lead President Donald Trump's Justice Department.

changes.title: Murkowski says she'll vote against Blanche's nomination for attorney general
changes.summary: Republican Sen. Lisa Murkowski said Friday she will oppose Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, narrowing the confirmation path for President Trump's pick to lead the Justice Department.

changes.title: Blanche's attorney general confirmation is in doubt as GOP Sen. Murkowski opposes his nomination
changes.summary: Republican Sen. Lisa Murkowski said Friday she will oppose Todd Blanche's nomination as attorney general, narrowing the confirmation path for President Donald Trump's pick to lead the Justice Department.

changes.title: State of New Mexico sues Justice Department and Todd Blanche, saying they blocked its Epstein probe
changes.summary: The state of New Mexico sued the Department of Justice and Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche on Wednesday, saying the federal government blocked the state's ability to investigate the sex crimes of financier Jeffrey Epstein at a ranch there.

changes.title: Senate Judiciary Committee advances Blanche's nomination for attorney general
changes.summary: The Senate Judiciary Committee voted along party lines to advance Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general.

changes.title: Todd Blanche Clears Committee Vote, Nearing Confirmation as Attorney General
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination now advances to the Senate floor, where it was not immediately clear whether he would be confirmed given that he can afford to lose only two senators on a party-line vote.

changes.title: Sen. Alex Padilla, D-Calif., on expected vote to advance Todd Blanche's nomination
changes.summary: NPR's Steve Inskeep speaks with Sen. Alex Padilla, D-Calif., about the Senate Judiciary Committee's anticipated vote on Todd Blanche's nomination for attorney general.

changes.title: Todd Blanche Clears Committee Vote, Paving Way for Attorney General Confirmation
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination now advances to the Senate floor, where he is expected to be confirmed, even though several Republicans have not yet committed to supporting him.
